zh.title: TCab Tech與SIDEC交換備忘錄 探索E20在馬來西亞商業化
zh.summary: TCab Tech與SIDEC交換備忘錄，探索E20在馬來西亞商業化
body: TCab Tech與Selangor Information Technology and Digital Economy Corporation（SIDEC）交換合作備忘錄，探索E20電動垂直起降航空器在馬來西亞的商業化途徑，並推動當地低空經濟發展。備忘錄於展示活動開幕典禮上交換。

這場由SIDEC、TCab Tech及IOI City Mall共同舉辦的展示活動，於2026年10月9日在馬來西亞布城的IOI City Mall開幕，展出TCab Tech五人座、傾轉旋翼構型的E20 eVTOL，並標示為該機在馬來西亞首度亮相。備忘錄載明，TCab Tech將提供eVTOL研發及製造專業，SIDEC則將協助對接相關政府機構、馬來西亞民航局及業界人士，以推進E20的認證途徑及未來商業化。TCab Tech也將在馬來西亞設立區域業務中心。

en.title: TCab Tech and SIDEC exchange MOU to explore E20 commercialization in Malaysia
en.summary: TCab Tech and SIDEC exchange an MOU to explore E20 commercialization in Malaysia.
body: TCab Tech and the Selangor Information Technology and Digital Economy Corporation (SIDEC) exchanged a memorandum of understanding to explore commercialization pathways for the E20 eVTOL in Malaysia and advance the development of the country’s Low Altitude Economy ecosystem. The MOU was exchanged during the opening ceremony of a showcase.

The showcase, jointly organized by SIDEC, TCab Tech and IOI City Mall, opened at IOI City Mall in Putrajaya, Malaysia, on October 9, 2026. It featured the Malaysian debut of TCab Tech’s five-seat, tilt-rotor E20 eVTOL. Under the MOU, TCab Tech will contribute eVTOL research, development and manufacturing expertise. SIDEC will support engagement with relevant government agencies, the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia and industry stakeholders to advance the E20’s certification pathway and future commercialization. TCab Tech will also establish a regional business center in Malaysia.

zh.title: 國防部稱偵獲中共軍機13架次出海 其中11架次逾越中線
zh.summary: 國防部稱偵獲13架次中共軍機出海，其中11架次逾越中線
body: 國防部表示，自上午9時30分起，陸續偵獲中共各型軍機13架次出海，其中11架次逾越中線，進入臺灣北部、中部及西南空域。國防部稱，相關軍機配合共艦活動，並以「聯合戰備警巡」之名在臺灣周邊空、海域活動。
國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握，並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統適切應處。國防部將相關活動描述為對臺灣周邊空、海域的騷擾。

en.title: Taiwan defence ministry reports 13 Chinese military aircraft sorties, 11 crossing median line
en.summary: Taiwan's defence ministry reports 13 sorties; 11 aircraft crossed the median line
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 13 sorties by Chinese military aircraft departing over the sea from 9:30 a.m. It said 11 sorties crossed the median line and entered airspace north, central and southwest of Taiwan.

The ministry said the aircraft operated alongside Chinese vessels under what it described as a “joint combat readiness patrol,” and characterized the activity as harassment in the air and waters around Taiwan. Taiwan's armed forces used joint intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance measures to monitor the activity, and dispatched mission aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems to respond.

zh.title: IATA與World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance合作制定飯店採購永續指引
zh.summary: IATA與World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance合作，聚焦航空公司飯店採購永續指引
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）與World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance（WSHA）已同意加強航空與旅宿業的永續合作。雙方在World Sustainability Symposium簽署協議，初期聚焦航空公司採購飯店住宿服務。
雙方將運用IATA的Integrated Sustainability Program（ISP）及WSHA的Universal Sustainability KPIs Programme，共同制定航空公司採購飯店住宿的實務永續指引。指引將納入飯店招標的永續評估標準、合約相關ESG考量及最佳實務案例。較長期可能合作領域包括永續績效衡量與報告、減塑減廢、社區參與與人權、氣候韌性及資源效率。

en.title: IATA and World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance to Develop Hotel Procurement Guidance
en.summary: IATA and WSHA agree to develop sustainability guidance for airlines' hotel procurement
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance (WSHA) have agreed to strengthen sustainability alignment between the airline and hospitality sectors. The agreement was signed at the World Sustainability Symposium, with airline procurement of hotel services as its initial focus.

The organizations will jointly develop practical guidance for airlines procuring hotel accommodation, using IATA’s Integrated Sustainability Program and WSHA’s Universal Sustainability KPIs Programme. The guidance will cover sustainability evaluation criteria for hotel tenders, ESG concerns in contracting and best-practice case studies. Potential longer-term areas of cooperation include sustainability measurement and reporting, plastic and waste reduction, community engagement and human rights, climate resilience, and resource efficiency.
